title: alyssum parviflorum var. collinum
intro: Alyssum parviflorum var. collinum, commonly known as Collina Alyssum, is a flowering plant in the mustard family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions, such as wounds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Collina Alyssum include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
